verdicts.reason: A and B are pixel-identical. Both have the same broken hierarchy: the body copy at bottom left is set larger than anything near it, while the 'Reserve a Case' button is shrunk to a tiny pill crammed into the right column next to legal text you can't read. The 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow is dropped or shrunk to an illegible size, the orange divider floats loose, the 'Ships late June' text is microscopic, and the right column is ragged and doesn't line up with the left text block.
